criteria.text: A mobile session created for a known profile sends the same mcpAllowlist and skillAllowlist to the OpenCode engine as the desktop create path for that profile, and profileId is not forwarded to the engine.
criteria.test_id: issue-1282-c1: mobile and desktop send identical profile scope to the engine

criteria.text: The mobile client includes its selected Rhythm profile identifier in the same request that creates the engine session.
criteria.test_id: issue-1282-c2: mobile sends the selected profile in the create request

criteria.text: A mobile caller cannot use an unknown profile identifier to fall through to an unrestricted engine session.
criteria.test_id: issue-1282-c3: an unknown mobile profile is rejected before engine create
